messages:
Samir Patel: Quick heads-up: noticed some tenants dropping their QoS bucket after pool reshuffles. Leases come back without the priority annotation. Anyone else?

Jing Wu: Saw that in staging around 03:20. The lease object was recreated and the rwd.priority_bucket annotation was missing. Operator reconcile path seems to not persist admission metadata.

Kevin Morales: I dug in a bit. The admission side hands out a token with priority, but the operator treats that as ephemeral; when it re-creates leases during shard reassign it doesn't copy token fields back into the Lease object.

Anya Kuznetsova: That explains customer-facing preemption surprises. Two ways forward: (1) make the priority a first-class field on Lease.spec so it's durable, or (2) make the operator strictly copy from the admission store on any create path. (1) has migration cost but less long-term footguns.

Samir Patel: Agree. Short-term we need a safe quick patch. Longer-term we should land a CRD change. Also need to think about operator rollouts and backward compatibility.

Jing Wu: Short-term proposal: operator writes annotation "rwd.priority_bucket" to the Lease before attaching a pod to the node. Add a background backfill job that finds Leases without that annotation and fills them from the admission store.

Kevin Morales: Implementation note: the write must happen before attach to avoid a race where attach triggers scheduler decisions. We should perform an optimistic Update on the Lease (check resourceVersion) to avoid stomping. Also add a small retry loop for conflicts.

Anya Kuznetsova: If we end up with two canonical sources (admission store vs Lease) we need a clear canonicalization strategy. I prefer Lease.spec as the canonical source and admission becomes a transient writer until migration completes.

Samir Patel: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Hotfix: operator emits annotation pre-attach + backfill job. 2) Metrics/alert: create alert if any lease gets attached without rwd.priority_bucket. 3) RFC & CRD: add PriorityBucket string to Lease.spec, operator enforces write and read semantics. 4) Migration window with feature-gate.

Jing Wu: I'll own the e2e tests: simulate scale-down/scale-up, eviction + reassign, verify priority survives. Also add unit tests for reconcile create/update.

Kevin Morales: I'll prototype reconcile change and add concurrency tests that simulate simultaneous shard reassigns to make sure we don't end up with missing annotations.

Anya Kuznetsova: I'll add metrics + alert: a gauge "rwd.lease_priority_missing_count" and an alert if >0 for 5m in staging, and a separate P1 if seen in prod. Also will prepare the feature-gate flag for the CRD migration.

infra-bot: deploy-notify: operator/lease-propagation patch pushed to staging (tag: lease-prop-hotfix-2026-03-21).

Samir Patel: Nice. For the RFC I'll include: CRD schema, migration steps, test matrix, and rollout plan (canary -> staging -> prod). Ping me for sections.

Jing Wu: Pinged. I'll start the backfill job PR and link the e2e once ready.

Kevin Morales: Sending initial reconcile patch in ~2 hours. Will add the optimistic update + conflict retries.

Anya Kuznetsova: Adding alert PR now. Also documenting the invariants in the operator README so on-call knows what to look for.

Samir Patel: Thanks everyone. Follow up here after the RFC is up or if anything blocks the hotfix. :rocket:
